characters.summary: Elephant Peach transforms Princess Peach into a bulky elephantine form that uses her massive size and trunk for heavy melee strikes and clearing obstacles.

mechanisms: Increased mass and durability from the Elephant Fruit

limitations: Transformation depends on holding the Elephant Power-Up
characters.formDifferences: Transforms Princess Peach into an elephant form, granting enhanced melee reach, the ability to store water in her trunk, and block-breaking power at the cost of standard agility.

sources.supports: Elephant Peach transformation, trunk attacks, and enhanced physical attributes.

unknowns: Exact duration of the Elephant Fruit transformation before reverting to normal.

characters.summary: Radiant Peach harnesses sparkling stage magic to cleanse corruption, restore environments, and project powerful magical beams against theatrical enemies.
limitations: Relies on the presence of Sparkle energy or magical performance conditions
characters.formDifferences: Grants Peach glowing stage-magical attacks, flight-like floating jumps, and purification powers tied to the Sparkle theater setting.

sources.supports: Radiant Peach abilities, Sparkle power usage, and cleansing theatrical corruption.

unknowns: Whether Radiant Peach abilities can be used outside of magical theatrical environments.

characters.summary: Swordfighter Peach is a specialized form equipped with fencing foils, allowing her to execute rapid thrusts, parries, and acrobatic counterattacks.
limitations: Melee range limitation; requires the Swordfighter transformation ribbon
characters.formDifferences: Equips Peach with dual fencing swords and high-speed martial agility, replacing her standard dress or magical transformations with direct swordplay.

sources.supports: Swordfighter Peach transformation, fencing techniques, and melee combat feats.

unknowns: Durability of the swords against heavy magical attacks.

characters.summary: Professor Samuel Oak is a renowned Pokémon researcher and mentor rather than an active combatant, though he possesses a full roster of high-level Pokémon in unused game data.

mechanisms: Guarded by research assistants or Pokémon

weaknesses: Physically elderly and unsuited for direct hand-to-hand combat
limitations: Fights exclusively through trained Pokémon rather than direct personal action

sources.supports: Professor Oak's role as a Pokémon researcher, mentor, and developer of the Pokédex.

unknowns: Whether his unused battle data from Pokémon Red and Blue constitutes official canon combat capability.

characters.summary: Pyramid Head is an unrelenting supernatural executioner that drags a massive Great Knife and employs physical brutality to stalk its targets.
weaknesses: Bound to the psychological torments and guilt of Silent Hill's protagonists

sources.supports: Pyramid Head appearance in Silent Hill 2, use of the Great Knife, and supernatural resilience.

unknowns: Whether Pyramid Head can manifest outside of the psychic boundaries of Silent Hill.

characters.summary: Q*bert is a small orange creature that navigates isometric pyramidal grids, jumping between cubes to change their colors while avoiding enemies.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to falling off open grid edges
limitations: Cannot attack directly without environment hazards or magic discs

sources.supports: Q*bert gameplay mechanics, grid navigation, and avoiding Coily.

notableResults.note: Lured Coily off the edge of the pyramid using a flying disc.

unknowns: Combat capabilities outside of an isometric grid environment.

characters.continuity: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots
characters.summary: Raiden is a high-frequency cyborg ninja who utilizes extreme superhuman speed, acrobatics, and a high-frequency blade to slice through heavily armored opponents.
weaknesses: Susceptible to severe structural damage if internal cybernetics are overwhelmed
Requires periodic maintenance or battery power
limitations: Melee focus with limited ranged firepower

sources.supports: Raiden's cyborg ninja transformation in Metal Gear Solid 4, high-frequency blade, and superhuman agility.

notableResults.citation: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots
notableResults.note: Defeated Vamp in hand-to-hand cyborg combat after suppressing his nanomachine healing factor.

campaignTags.claim: Raiden's body is heavily augmented with cybernetics as a cyborg ninja.

unknowns: Full operational limits of his cyborg body without Patriot life support.

characters.summary: Raiden is the eternal God of Thunder, commanding raw electricity, teleportation, and martial arts to strike down mortals and immortals alike.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to powerful magic or divine containment methods
limitations: Powers can be taxed or drained when exerting immense divine energy

sources.supports: Raiden's status as God of Thunder, electricity manipulation, and teleportation.

campaignTags.claim: Raiden controls and projects high-voltage electricity as the God of Thunder.
Raiden generates and shapes lightning for offensive strikes.
Raiden instantly teleports across short or long distances in combat.

unknowns: Extent of his power fluctuations when stripped of his Elder God status.

characters.summary: Ratchet is an experienced Lombax mechanic and combatant who wields an expansive arsenal of destructive futuristic firearms and gadgets to obliterate enemies.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on carrying external weapons and ammunition
limitations: Weapons require ammo pickups or recharging

sources.supports: Ratchet's arsenal of futuristic weapons, OmniWrench, and dimensional gadgetry.

campaignTags.claim: Ratchet utilizes a wide variety of high-tech devices and weaponry in combat.
Ratchet builds and upgrades complex technological weaponry and gear.

unknowns: Performance limits of specific experimental weaponry against cosmic-tier entities.
